description:
Play Drownyard Temple triggering landfall.
Tap Drownyard Temple for {C}.
Use Amulet of Vigor to untap Drownyard Temple and Embodiment of Fury to make Drownyard Temple a creature.
Sacrifice Drownyard Temple to Ashnod's Altar.
Play Drownyard Temple from your graveyard.
Amulet of Vigor untaps it.
Repeat.
